q: How much CO2 does a Dhanbad hard coke plant emit per tonne of coke?
title: Dhanbad hard coke: CO2 per tonne
short: Use a carbon balance: carbon in the coal charged, minus carbon leaving in coke, breeze and any tar sold, times 44/12. In non recovery ovens most volatile matter burns on site, so that carbon becomes your CO2. Test coal and coke for carbon instead of using a flat factor.
audience: Hard coke and non recovery coke oven units in Dhanbad and Jharkhand

ul: Coal charged per batch and its carbon content.
Coke and breeze produced and their carbon content.
Fuel used to start or heat ovens.

p: If oven gas raises steam for power, the CO2 is the same but you buy less grid power. Count the burning once, in Scope 1.
Coke itself is not a CBAM good, but foundries and steel mills that use it will ask for its footprint as a precursor or Scope 3 input.
